stories.title: Alonso hits 300th HR to tie game in 9th, gets curtain call at Citi Field
stories.summary: Pete Alonso launched his 300th career home run, a tying shot in the ninth inning against his former team that earned a curtain call, and Coby Mayo's inside-the-park homer in the 11th sent the Orioles to a 7-5 victory over the Mets.

stories.title: Brewers clinch 4th straight NL Central title with win, Cubs loss
stories.summary: The Brewers won their fourth straight National League Central title after the second-place Cubs lost to Atlanta on Tuesday night.

stories.title: Horns' Manning apologizes for 'insensitive' reaction to violent AI video
stories.summary: Texas QB Arch Manning has apologized for an "insensitive comment" about an AI-generated video that depicted coach Steve Sarkisian slapping ESPN's Holly Rowe.

stories.title: Rocchio's heroics in 9th rescue Guardians, doom Taylor, White Sox again
stories.summary: Brayan Rocchio walked off the White Sox with a two-out, two-strike base hit down the left-field line that plated two runs and turned a 6-5 deficit into a 7-6 Cleveland win Tuesday night.

stories.title: Celtics' George ready to prove self in wake of controversial trade
stories.summary: Paul George acknowledged Celtics fans' angst toward the trade that sent Jaylen Brown to Philadelphia for him, saying it's understandable.
